rows.preview: Identify high-reach hooks, proof types and offers in last-30-day skincare short-form video across TikTok, Reels, Shorts.

messages.markdown:
# DTC Skincare Short-Form: What Earns Views Right Now

Analysis of 330 short-form videos (TikTok, Reels, Shorts, published 2026-09-17 to 2026-10-17; median 21,530 views) evaluated against five observable predicates.

1. Open with a hook in the first 3 seconds — it is near-universal: 321 of 330 videos (97%) state or show a clear hook immediately, with a median of 20,294 views. Top example: @heylina2484 (18.9M views) opens on the result.
2. Visible before-and-after proof earns outsized reach: 136 of 330 videos (41%) show a skin result on camera, median 45,940 views — roughly 2x the overall median. Example: @iamfainna (4.5M views).
3. Name one active ingredient: 196 of 330 videos (59%) name retinol, niacinamide, vitamin C or similar, median 28,208 views. Authority-led explainers are a repeatable launch format, e.g. @jessteaskincare (990K views).
4. Offer-led videos are rarer but direct-response ready: only 56 of 330 (17%) mention a price, discount, bundle or code, median 7,918 views — they convert rather than maximize reach. Example: @organofora bundle (4.0M views).
5. Creator speaks to camera in only 84 of 330 (25%), median 18,852 views — voiceover plus close-up application outperforms talking-head for proof. Example: @fashionable.boy0 (1.3M views).

Copy this: result-first hook + one ingredient + one claim + product applied mid-routine; save price/code for promo cuts.

prompts.label: Compare TikTok and Reels winners
prompts.prompt: Compare what wins on TikTok with what wins on Instagram Reels in this research. Which format should we test first?

response.markdown:
### TikTok vs. Instagram Reels: Where the Reach Is

**TikTok wins on raw transformation proof and scale.** Across our pool, TikTok drove massive viral reach (median 9,796 views, 117 videos >100k, 18 >1M), led by unfiltered visual contrasts like @heylina2484 (18.9M views) and multi-week pore results like @febisola_iris (3.9M views). Fast pacing and rapid macro shots dominate.

**Instagram Reels favors curated routine aesthetics and authority.** Reels showed lower overall ceiling (median 1,454 views, 4 videos >100k), winning through polished, aesthetic morning routines like @jasminbhasin2806 (393K views) and clinical advice like @dr_anupamabisaria_dermat (218K views) or product swaps from @thebudgetdermatologist (67K views).

### Which format to test first?
**Test the TikTok-style 3-second result proof first.** In this dataset, visible skin proof generated a median **45,940 views**—more than double the baseline. A 15–25 second raw before-and-after clip (like @iamfainna (4.5M views)) provides the fastest organic validation and scales effectively across both platforms.

prompts.label: Find creators worth briefing
prompts.prompt: Which creators in this research appear more than once in the top videos? List them with their best-performing hook.

response.markdown:
### Creators Appearing Multiple Times in the Top 40

Four creators achieved multiple placements in the **Top 40 Videos** section:

1. **@ugc_anouki (3 videos in Top 40)**
   - *Best-performing hook:* **The "Secret Sculpting Routine"** in @ugc_anouki (368K views)—opens immediately showing a lifted jawline contour before demonstrating application. Two more in the Top 40, at 286K and 282K views.

2. **@thebodyytemple (2 videos in Top 40)**
   - *Best-performing hook:* **The "Barrier Hydration Contrast"** in @thebodyytemple (974K views)—leads with close-up bare skin texture and instant milk-toner glaze. One more in the Top 40, at 335K views.

3. **@mmarruss (2 videos in Top 40)**
   - *Best-performing hook:* **The "Fake Concealer" Disruption** in @mmarruss (457K views)—opens with *"What concealer? It's actually skincare,"* showing instant under-eye brightening. One more in the Top 40, at 250K views.

4. **@illaalvarez (2 videos in Top 40)**
   - *Best-performing hook:* **The "No More Breakout Panic" Pivot** in @illaalvarez (445K views)—zooms in on an active blemish and immediately cuts to post-treatment faded marks. One more in the Top 40, at 229K views.

sections.title: Before-and-after proof in the first three seconds
sections.why: Creators who open on the result, then explain the routine — these hold attention without a hard pitch.

sections.title: Dermatologist and ingredient explainers
sections.why: Authority-led videos that name one active and one claim — a repeatable format for a serum or SPF launch.

sections.title: Routine videos that sell without a pitch
